name: WPJshop
description: Thanks to this connector, you can connect your e-shop on the WPJshop platform directly with AI assistant Instead of working in the administration panel, you simply ask in natural language - even for information that would otherwise be difficult to find - and the AI will answer based on real-time data from your e-shop.

_published_faq.name: How do I add WPJshop to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add WPJshop to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.wpjshop.cz/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the WPJshop MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: WPJshop provides these MCP tools: introspect-operation-types, introspect-schema-operations, mutate-graphql, query-graphql, and report-mcp-issue.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to WPJshop?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to WPJshop in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and RCO-A2A.
WPJshop requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
WPJshop is developed by wpj s.r.o.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
